title: Mars in 360: virtual tour of four craters seen from the ground
description: Four 360-degree views of the surface of Mars, the fourth planet from the Sun, a desert-like rocky world with a thin carbon dioxide atmosphere and a diameter about half the Earth's. These are not rover photographs: Kevin M. Gill projected them from digital terrain models and orthoimages of HiRISE, the camera of NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter, in orbit since 2006. The tour visits Domoni crater, a crater in western Arabia Terra with stair-stepped hills and dark dunes, a well-preserved 9-kilometre impact crater and the inside of Rauna crater. Data: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona/USGS.

scenes.title: Domoni crater
scenes.alt: Rendered 360-degree view from inside Domoni crater on Mars: orange-brown rippled slopes and dunes rising to the crater rim, a small low sun on the horizon and a dark blue-violet sky
scenes.desc: Domoni crater, in the Diacria quadrangle of Mars, projected from HiRISE digital terrain and image data by Kevin M. Gill (2017).
scenes.author: Kevin M. Gill

scenes.title: Crater in western Arabia Terra
scenes.alt: Rendered 360-degree view of a crater floor in western Arabia Terra on Mars: yellow-ochre plains pitted with small craters, stair-stepped hills on the horizon, dark dunes and a hazy sky lit by a low sun
scenes.desc: A crater floor in western Arabia Terra, a large, densely cratered and heavily eroded upland in the north of Mars, presumed to be one of the oldest terrains on the planet. HiRISE data set PSP_002047_1890.
scenes.author: Kevin M. Gill

scenes.title: A well-preserved 9-kilometre impact crater
scenes.alt: Rendered 360-degree view from the floor of a well-preserved 9-kilometre impact crater on Mars: a ring of terraced cliffs all around the horizon, ochre ground and a bright sun glowing over the rim; a thin line across the floor is a seam between data sets
scenes.desc: The floor of a very well preserved impact crater about 9 km in diameter. The long line visible on the ground is a seam between overlapping HiRISE data sets, not a real feature.
scenes.author: Kevin M. Gill

scenes.title: Inside Rauna crater
scenes.alt: Rendered 360-degree view within Rauna crater on Mars: a smooth ochre bowl with the crater rim running around the horizon and the sun rising behind it in a pale violet sky
scenes.desc: The interior of Rauna crater, projected from HiRISE digital terrain model ESP_034934_2155.
scenes.author: Kevin M. Gill

_notas: Las cuatro imágenes son proyecciones 360 generadas por Kevin M. Gill a partir de modelos digitales del terreno de HiRISE (NASA/JPL/Universidad de Arizona/USGS), no fotografías tomadas en superficie; la descripción lo dice. placeCountry «US» porque Marte no tiene país: es el origen de los datos (NASA); sin lat/lng terrestres.
